cards.title: Quality gate: checkMesh -meshQuality, not “Mesh OK”
cards.when: a decision “the mesh is usable” is needed
cards.statement: A bare checkMesh does not test non-orthogonality against a threshold: only >90° is an error and >70° is printed for information. Threshold checks are enabled by the -meshQuality flag and system/meshQualityDict — in this project through tools/qa/mesh_gate.sh. The project verdict is rc=0 from mesh_gate --profile project.
recipe: mesh_check({ caseDir, profile: "project", minVol: 1e-14 })
read the threshold metrics in the mesh_gate output: non-orthogonality > 60 degrees : N, faces with face pyramid volume < ... : N
negative volume = 0 and uncovered faces = 0 are mandatory
for a multi-region case the gate is called per region (overlay constant/polyMesh)
evidence: exp-018: v13_best passes project rc=0; 61–75° does not

cards.title: The minVol gate threshold is an absolute volume too
cards.statement: In meshQualityDict minVol is an absolute volume (m³), not a cell fraction. The template 1e-13 with a pore cell of 0.05–0.1 mm flags normal cells as illegal. Rule: minVol ≈ h_min³/6, and pass the same value to the gate.
recipe: h_min 0.1 mm → minVol ≈ 1.7e-13; h_min 0.05 mm → ≈ 2e-14
mesh_check({ minVol: 1e-16 }) for the finest pore meshes
do not mix profiles: minVol does not belong to the profile, it is a separate argument
evidence: exp-003: 63 792/70 784 false illegal faces; exp-005: minVol 1e-13 → 419 044 illegal, 0 layers

cards.title: Mesh delivery — two distributions in one command
cards.when: the mesh passed the gate and must be handed to the user or a simulation engineer
cards.statement: mesh_deliver (a wrapper around tools/deliver/make_delivery.sh) builds openfoam_<name>/ (a real constant/ + .foam marker), .tar.gz, ansys_<name>/<name>.msh + read_mesh.jou, .zip and a delivery_<name>.{json,md} report. Multi-region is detected automatically; the .msh round-trip is checked with fluent3DMeshToFoam and the CHT interface by the <a>_to_<b> pairs.
recipe: mesh_check({caseDir, minVol}) — PASS and a fresh mesh-passport.json (written by mesh_check itself)
mesh_deliver({caseDir, name, minVol, gateProfile:"project"}) — dryRun prints the command
the user opens: paraview openfoam_<name>/<name>.foam
do not rename or nest constant/ in a subdirectory — otherwise the case does not open as expected
for CHT check the interface pairs <a>_to_<b> ↔ <b>_to_<a>: the face counts must match
evidence: 0.4.0: v13_best CHT 575757 cells — interface ok, both regions PASS, round-trip ok, 66.6 s; FCC 27424 — 3.5 s

cards.title: Polyhedra: read .msh only with fluent3DMeshToFoam
cards.statement: foamMeshToFluent writes polyhedra (snappy produces them at the snap stage). fluentMeshToFoam v2512 fails on them: `FOAM FATAL ERROR: unrecognised 3-D cell shape: 7`; meshio 5.3.5 — `KeyError: 5` in _read_faces. The back check is legacy fluent3DMeshToFoam only (cells/patches/volume match).
recipe: OpenFOAM → Fluent: foamMeshToFluent (file under fluentInterface/)
verify the .msh back: fluent3DMeshToFoam
compare cells/patches/volume with the original
Fluent itself supports polyhedra

cards.title: ParaView screenshots — only via the headless EGL recipe
cards.when: geometry/mesh images are needed for a report
cards.statement: Headless rendering works through pvpython with EGL: `VTK_DEFAULT_OPENGL_WINDOW=vtkEGLRenderWindow EGL_PLATFORM=surfaceless LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 pvpython --force-offscreen-rendering`. The tools/pv/pv_view.sh wrapper sets this itself; without --force-offscreen-rendering it fails with X_GLXCreateContext.
recipe: tools/pv/pv_view.sh --input <stl|case dir> --out view/<name>.png --views all --edges
colour by a metric: --color-by volume|aspect|surface|constant (nonortho is slow, small meshes only)
put PNGs in the experiment directory or view/, not in /tmp
VTK 9.7: face orientation for wedge/polyhedron is inverted — pv_metrics already normalises it
evidence: exp-001, D-009; AGENTS.md §7.2 and §13 (on the project machine: a 1-mln-cell slice takes 4.9 s on the GPU)

cards.title: Rejected routes: cut-cell and polyDualMesh
cards.statement: Cut-cell (NinjaMesher) is unsuitable for CHT; polyDualMesh loses cellZones and increases the interface area by 81.5 %. Both routes are closed by decisions D-015/D-016 — do not spend time on them without a new reason.
recipe: CHT: one volume mesh + cellZones → splitMeshRegions (D-011)
conformal CHT: gmsh OCC route D (D-016)
polyhedra: only if the customer demands a pMesh mesh, with a separate explanation of the gate failure
evidence: exp-012 cut-cell; exp-013 polyDualMesh (cellZones lost, interface +81.5 %)

cards.title: Fluent has not been launched from this project yet
cards.when: planning a Fluent Meshing/Workbench run or a .msh check
cards.statement: Fluent v261 is installed; the licence is set through ANSYSLMD_LICENSE_FILE=<port>@<license-host> (value from ~/.bashrc). Launching it from an agent needs danger-full-access: the licence daemon writes to /var/tmp and ~/.ansys. The project .msh has not been opened in Fluent itself yet — status 🔴, do not present it as verified.
recipe: launch only on an explicit user request
set ANSYSLMD_LICENSE_FILE=<port>@<license-host> (do not hardcode someone else's address)
check: Fluent opens the .msh and prints orthogonal quality/skewness — record it in the journal
